sources.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Boise National Forest
sources.supports: Identifies Troutdale Campground on Forest Service Road 268 in Boise National Forest.
USGS Sheep Creek quadrangle places Troutdale Campground alongside the Middle Fork Boise River.
Describes the river immediately below the campground, walk-down bank access, and river recreation context.

sourceAssessment: Forest Service and USGS records establish the campground and river setting; current access guidance supports the riverside access area. Retain as a conditional campground anchor requiring same-day road and bank checks.
